claims.object_text: postictal decrease in ventilation and severely depressed the HCVR
claims.quote: we studied Scn1a R1407X/+ (Dravet syndrome; DS) and Scn8a N1768D/+ (D/+) mice of both sexes, two models of SUDEP, and found that convulsive seizures caused a postictal decrease in ventilation and severely depressed the HCVR in a subset of animals.
Those mice with severe postictal depression of the HCVR also exhibited transient postictal hypothermia.

claims.object_text: mimicked seizure-induced hypoventilation; partially occluded the postictal decrease in the HCVR; exacerbated hypothermia; increased postictal mortality in DS mice
claims.quote: Depleting 5-HT with para-chlorophenylalanine (PCPA) mimicked seizure-induced hypoventilation, partially occluded the postictal decrease in the HCVR, exacerbated hypothermia, and increased postictal mortality in DS mice.

claims.object_text: fenfluramine reduced postictal inhibition of the HCVR and hypothermia
claims.quote: Conversely, pretreatment with the 5-HT agonist fenfluramine reduced postictal inhibition of the HCVR and hypothermia.
